comment: Not a perfboard drawing: an etched-PCB layout (component silkscreen over blue copper, with the bare copper beside it) of the EarthQuaker Devices Tentacle octave-up, three transistors, no pots. Values are printed in lowercase without units (47n, 100µ). The board has pads for the bypass 3PDT, jacks and an indicator LED; the LED is listed with no type because none is printed.
rows: indicator, pads on the board, no type printed
